title: Good news
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do negative stories often dominate the news even though many positive things happen?
Do you actively look for good news, or does it feel less important than bad news?
Can too much positive reporting make people less aware of serious problems?
What kind of good news has the strongest effect on your mood: personal, local, scientific, or global?
If you ran a news website, how would you balance positive and negative stories?
